assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Alice uses an isolated browser profile with the synthetic identity and permissions defined for this case
2. And Alice has catalog permission for the synthetic tile with exact title "T-CACHE"
3. And Alice has completed opening T-CACHE V1
4. And The controlled server now serves the complete T-CACHE V2 build
5. And the controlled login deployment enables the local Username and Password form
6. When Alice clicks the icon button with tooltip "User Profiles" in the portal application bar
7. And Alice clicks the menu item labeled "Logout" in the user profile menu
8. And Alice clicks the button labeled "Logout" in dialog "Leave Now?"
9. And Alice fills the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" with "alice" on the Sign In page
10. And Alice fills the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" with the fixture password on the Sign In page
11. And Alice clicks the button labeled "Sign In" on the Sign In page
12. And Alice clicks the text "New Tile" on the portal workspace page
13. Then the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options" is visible on the portal workspace page
14. When Alice clicks the text "T-CACHE" in the drawer panel headed by "Tile Options"
15. Then The T-CACHE fixture displays tile-version marker "V2"

annotations.description: Actual current React shell and real Chromium HTTP cache. Local HTTP fixture server supplies synthetic Alice, permissions, base entry wrapper, container, tile, trade, lazy content, CSS and images. V1/V2 markers identify controlled fixture assets. No browser routing, production CDN, real business tenant, or changed base binary acceptance.
